narrative.intro: Acquisition Logistics has $609M in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Acquisition Logistics secured 5 awards so far, with an average award size of $122M, and obligations are up 131.5% year over year. Acquisition Logistics shows a recent surge compared with previous fiscal years: FY25 recorded $263M, while FY24 and FY22 each recorded $4.1M and FY23 recorded $6.7M. Acquisition Logistics receives nearly all FY2026 obligations from a small set of buyers. Acquisition Logistics recorded $598M from the Department of Homeland Security and $10.8M from the Department of Defense. Acquisition Logistics sells mainly in the Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services market, where obligations total $609M, with a smaller position in Other Support Activities for Water Transportation at $311K. The current-year totals are fiscal year to date and partial. The figures reflect contract obligations except for award-value entries listed as total contract values in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables.
